name: IFTTT
summary: No-code service linking 1,000+ apps and devices through simple trigger-action applets.
description: IFTTT connects more than 1,000 services, including Google apps, webhooks, Discord, Slack and smart home devices, through applets that run an action when a trigger fires. It is aimed at individuals and small businesses rather than complex enterprise workflows. A free plan allows using published applets; paid tiers start at $2.99 per month billed annually and $8.99 per month for multi-step and filter features.

howToUse.title: Open IFTTT
howToUse.description: Open IFTTT and choose Get started or Start building.

howToUse.title: Connect a trigger to an action
howToUse.description: Create an applet that connects services. Choose a trigger, pick an action, and customize it so the action runs when the trigger fires. Services include Google apps, webhooks, Discord, Slack, and smart home devices, among more than 1,000.

howToUse.title: Enable a published applet
howToUse.description: Enable a published applet when you want one that already exists. The free plan allows using published applets.

howToUse.title: Move to a paid tier for longer applets
howToUse.description: Paid tiers start at $2.99 per month billed annually. The tier at $8.99 per month adds multi-step and filter features. IFTTT is aimed at individuals and small businesses.
